## PlayerRestrictedAreaFile

PlayerRestrictedAreaFile defines a restricted player area and safe positions for
that area.

| Attribute | Value |
| --- | --- |
| Type | `object` |
| Properties | 3 |
| Additional properties | boolean schema=false |

### PlayerRestrictedAreaFile.PRABoxes

Key: `PRABoxes`

PRABoxes defines rotated 3D boxes. Each box contains three XYZ vectors in order:
size, rotation, and world position.

| Attribute | Value |
| --- | --- |
| Type | `array` |
| Required | no |
| Items type | `array` |

### PlayerRestrictedAreaFile.areaName

Key: `areaName`

AreaName is an optional label used to identify the area in game diagnostics.

| Attribute | Value |
| --- | --- |
| Type | `string` |
| Required | no |
| Examples | `RestrictedAreaWarheadStorage` |

### PlayerRestrictedAreaFile.safePositions3D

Key: `safePositions3D`

SafePositions3D lists explicit XYZ destinations used when selecting a safe
position for this area.

| Attribute | Value |
| --- | --- |
| Type | `array` |
| Required | no |
| Items type | `array` |
